title: Bernd Brandes
body: Bernd Brandes — 9 March 2001 — The 43-year-old engineer was voluntarily slaughtered and eaten by Armin Meiwes following an appointment via the Internet. At Brandes' request, Meiwes first severed Brandes' penis, and they unsuccessfully tried to eat it. Meiwes taped the entire amputation, killing, conserving, and eating Brandes' meat. Meiwes was eventually arrested, tried, and sentenced to life in prison.
